name: Cole Hua 🧊 (Co-Host)
text: Welcome to Learn Cube 4 Fun! 🚀 I'm in Grade 4 and love speedcubing (practice PB 9.00s, official WCA 12.60s single). Feel free to ask questions about 3x3, 2x2, finger tricks, or our Wednesday Wesbrook classes!

name: Liam 🧩
text: I practiced the first layer algorithms Cole showed us and managed to solve the white cross in under 30 seconds! See you this Wednesday!

name: Cole Hua 🧊 (Co-Host)
text: Awesome job Liam! 🎉 That is super fast for the white cross. Next class we will practice corner placement and F2L finger tricks!

name: Sarah (Parent)
text: My son absolutely loves this class! Cole is an amazing teacher and makes learning the Rubik's cube so much fun. Highly recommend to any parents at UBC/Wesbrook!

name: Cole's Mom 👩‍👦
text: Thank you Sarah! It is wonderful seeing the kids help each other out and gain confidence solving puzzles! See you Wednesday!

name: David ⚡
text: Which cube should I buy to get faster? My current cube gets stuck when I turn fast.

name: Cole Hua 🧊 (Co-Host)
text: Check out the MoYu RS3M V5 (Magnetic) or the Super RS3M! They have corner-cutting and magnets so they never lock up, and they only cost about $9-$14. I also wrote about them on our Cubing News page!

name: Maya 🌟
text: The new 1 vs 1 Battle Timer on the homepage is so much fun! My brother and I raced each other on our iPad. I won on 2x2! 🏆

name: Cole Hua 🧊 (Co-Host)
text: Nice win Maya! 2x2 is all about fast recognition and finger tricks. Keep practicing and challenge him to 3x3 next! ⚔️
